chunks: O group of the Shia! Argue using Surah 'Verily We revealed it' (Al-Qadr) and you will prevail, for by Allah, it is the proof of Allah, Blessed and Most High, over creation after the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and it is the chief of your religion, and it is the summit of our knowledge.

O group of the Shia! Argue using: 'Ha Mim. By the Clarifying Book. Verily We revealed it on a Blessed Night. Verily We are warners' (Surah Al-Dukhan 44:1-3), for these verses pertain specifically to the Masters of Command after the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

O group of the Shia! Allah, Blessed and Most High, says: 'And there is not a community but a warner has passed among them' (35:24). It was said: O Abu Ja'far! The warner is Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). He said: You speak the truth. Was there a warner from the sent ones in the regions of the earth while he was alive? The questioner said: No. Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: What do you think — is not his emissary his warner, just as the Messenger of Allah in his mission from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, was a warner? He said: Yes. He said: Similarly, Muhammad did not die except that he had an emissary warner.

He said: If I were to say no, then the Messenger of Allah would have abandoned those in the loins of men from his community. He said: And does the Quran not suffice them? He said: Yes, if they find an interpreter for it. He said: And did the Messenger of Allah not interpret it? He said: Yes, he interpreted it to one man, and he explained to the community the status of that man — and he is Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).

The questioner said: O Abu Ja'far! This was a special matter that the general public cannot bear. He said: Allah refused to be worshipped except in secret until there comes the appointed time in which His religion is manifested, just as the Messenger of Allah was concealed with Khadijah until he was commanded with the proclamation.

The questioner said: It is fitting for the master of this religion to conceal. He said: Did not Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) conceal on the day he embraced Islam with the Messenger of Allah until his matter was revealed? He said: Yes. He said: Similarly is our matter, until the Book reaches its appointed term.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about Surah Al-Qadr as proof of the Imamate?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) delivers a theological discourse to his Shia followers, explaining the significance of Surah Al-Qadr (97) and Surah Al-Dukhan (44:1-3) as proofs of the Imamate after the Prophet. Through a question-and-answer dialogue, he establishes that just as every community had a warner sent by God, Muhammad did not die without appointing a successor warner — identified as Ali ibn Abi Talib — as the authoritative interpreter of the Quran. He also explains that the concealment of the Imam's true status is analogous to the early secrecy of Islam itself, until the appointed time for its manifestation arrives.
